component.name: Akev
component.summary: Intercept, inspect, mock and replay HTTP(S) traffic

description.p: Akev is a fast HTTP(S) debugging proxy. It intercepts traffic from browsers, terminals, Android devices, containers and whole systems, and shows every request as it happens.

ul.li: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket, server-sent events and gRPC
Breakpoints, mocks, rewrites, Map Local and Map Remote
Compose and replay requests, export them as code
An MCP server for AI agents
